svg.title: Where DPO sits in recipes: Llama 3 (rejection sampling, SFT, DPO, six rounds), Tulu 3 (SFT, DPO, RLVR), Llama 4 (light SFT, online RL, light DPO), Olmo 3 (SFT, delta-learning DPO, RLVR)
